mapper.insert: INSERT INTO USER_PERSONAL_TOKENS /* QueryID : com.demo.proworks.userpersonaltoken.insertUserPersonalToken */ ( USER_ID, ACCESS_TOKEN, SCOPE, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{accessToken}, #{scope}, NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE USER_PERSONAL_TOKENS /* QueryID : com.demo.proworks.userpersonaltoken.updateUserPersonalToken */ SET ACCESS_TOKEN = #{accessToken} , SCOPE = #{scope} , EXPIRED_AT = #{expiredAt} WHERE USER_PERSONAL_TOKEN_ID = #{userPersonalTokenId}
mapper.select: SELECT /* QueryID : com.demo.proworks.userpersonaltoken.selectUserPersonalToken */ USER_PERSONAL_TOKEN_ID as userPersonalTokenId, USER_ID as userId, ACCESS_TOKEN as accessToken, SCOPE as scope, CREATED_AT as createdAt, EXPIRED_AT as expiredAt FROM USER_PERSONAL_TOKENS WHERE USER_PERSONAL_TOKEN_ID = #{userPersonalTokenId}

SELECT /* QueryID : com.demo.proworks.userpersonaltoken.selectUserPersonalTokenByUserId */ USER_PERSONAL_TOKEN_ID as userPersonalTokenId, USER_ID as userId, ACCESS_TOKEN as accessToken, SCOPE as scope, CREATED_AT as createdAt, EXPIRED_AT as expiredAt FROM USER_PERSONAL_TOKENS WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT /* QueryID : com.demo.proworks.userpersonaltoken.selectListUserPersonalToken */ USER_PERSONAL_TOKEN_ID as userPersonalTokenId, USER_ID as userId, ACCESS_TOKEN as accessToken, SCOPE as scope, CREATED_AT as createdAt, EXPIRED_AT as expiredAt FROM ( SELECT S.*, CEIL( (@ROWNUM:=@ROWNUM+1) / #{pageSize} ) AS PAGE FROM ( SELECT * FROM USER_PERSONAL_TOKENS WHERE 1=1
) S, (SELECT @ROWNUM := 0) TMP ) A WHERE PAGE = #{pageIndex}
SELECT /* QueryID : com.demo.proworks.userpersonaltoken.selectListCountUserPersonalToken */ COUNT(*) totcnt FROM USER_PERSONAL_TOKENS WHERE 1=1
